Spanish 21 it is. You play on a 48-card deck with every ten-spot taken out (the J, Q and K stay in). Your 21 always wins, and your blackjack beats the dealer's blackjack. A 21 made with five or more cards pays a bonus, and so do 6-7-8 and 7-7-7. You can double after a split, and late surrender is allowed. Everything else plays like regular blackjack.

You're starting with 1,000 in chips. Set your bet on the table and deal when you're ready.
